goal: Create node/features/hours.py with active_hour_profile(tx) -> pl.DataFrame. tx columns: client_id, ts (UTC datetime), amount_czk, direction ('in'|'out'|'remit_out'), counterparty_token. 'outflow' means direction in ('out','remit_out'). For each client, count ALL transactions per hour of the day in Europe/Prague local time (ts.dt.convert_time_zone('Europe/Prague').dt.hour()) and normalise to sum 1. Output columns exactly: client_id, hour_hist (list of 24 floats, index = hour 0..23).
